entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-8675309.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. I can definitely help you with that. Let me just pull up the order.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return these cycling shoes?
I understand you're looking for a quick answer. Just so I can properly document this for you, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They're giving me terrible blisters right near the ball of my foot. Something about the plate where the cleats attach is just wrong for me. I don't want to troubleshoot, I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that, and I completely understand. No problem at all. I see here the order was delivered 18 days ago. Our policy for standard items like these shoes is a 90-day return window.

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next two minutes. Once we receive the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
